title: helianthemum croceum var. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum croceum var. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Cistaceae. The Rockrose plant is known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues due to its calming effects on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, fever, and wounds, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
